annotations.title: Check a PDF's accessibility against PDF/UA

description:
Check whether a PDF is accessible by PDF/UA, the ISO standard for accessible PDF.

veraPDF checks the machine-checkable rules of PDF/UA: tags, structure, alt
text present, fonts, metadata. Whether alt text or reading order make sense
still needs a person.

Input: `pdf_base64` is the PDF as base64, at most 4 MB decoded; or pass the
file as a download link in `file`. `profile` is "ua1" or "ua2".

Returns `compliant` (true or false), `profile_name`, `statement`,
`passed_rules`, `failed_rules` and `top_failed_rules`: up to 10 failed rules
with their `id` (clause and test number), `specification`, `description` and
`failed_checks`. A file that is not a PDF fails with `not_a_pdf`; an
unavailable veraPDF with `engine_unavailable`. For the full report, use the
REST API (`POST /v1/verapdf/api/validate/ua1`).

Credits: 10 per call.

file.description: The file as a download link, instead of `pdf_base64`. In ChatGPT, pass the user's uploaded file here. Other clients can set `download_url` to a public https URL.

download_url.description: A public https URL of the file.

file_id.description: An identifier for the file. ChatGPT sets it; other clients may pass any label, such as the file name.

pdf_base64.description: The PDF, base64-encoded. At most 4 MB decoded.

profile.description: "ua1" (the default) checks against PDF/UA-1 (ISO 14289-1), "ua2" against PDF/UA-2 (ISO 14289-2).
